# mvpfy

> mvpfy ("mvpfy by feature1") is a free, MIT-licensed, open-source desktop IDE for product
> managers. It clones a company's existing repositories, runs the product locally in Docker
> with a live preview and an embedded VS Code (code-server) editor, and lets a PM describe
> changes in plain language that an AI coding agent (Claude Code, optionally Codex CLI)
> applies and ships as pull requests for engineers to review.

Key facts:
- Positioning: "The IDE for PMs." Like Lovable or Replit, but for a company's EXISTING
  product, running locally, with a pull request (not a deploy) as the output.
- vs Cursor/Windsurf: those are code-first tools for engineers (unit of work: a diff).
  mvpfy is product-first (unit of work: a plain-language change or a user story); the PM
  never reads a diff.
- Runs on macOS (primary), Linux, Windows (experimental beta). Electron + React.
- Requires locally installed: git, GitHub CLI (gh), Docker Desktop, Claude Code (signed
  in). Codex CLI optional. Agent runs bill to the user's own Anthropic/OpenAI account.
- Privacy: no mvpfy server; repos and the running product stay on the user's machine.
  Code is sent to the model API only via the user's own agent CLI.
- Features: one-click Docker bootstrap with open-source stand-ins (Postgres, Redis,
  MailHog) for missing services; live app preview and embedded VS Code in tabs; demo
  logins and an editable env-vars card; plain-language change requests ("Ask mvpfy");
  self-healing failed runs (plain-English diagnosis + one-click fix/retry); container log
  streaming; repo sync; feature planning in the Feature1 style — a minimal PRD the PM
  reviews and agrees, then user stories with acceptance criteria on a per-feature board
  (To do → Coding → Testing → Done), each story implemented by the agent and shipped as a
  pull request the PM tests before marking done; multiple features plannable in parallel,
  each with its own board.
- Maker: feature1 (https://feature1.ai). Source: https://github.com/feature1-ai/mvpfy.ai
- Download: https://github.com/feature1-ai/mvpfy.ai/releases/latest
